dataset.n: CoCG Road Condition - Oriented Bounding Boxes (CoCGRCOBB)
dataset.dst: Single crack in any orientation (C12, merging C01 and C02); Alligator crack and surface-layer delamination (C03); Pothole and erosion cavity (C04)
dataset.acq: Vehicle-mounted USB Logitech Brio camera on the car radiator grille
dataset.lim: Re-annotation of the same 2110 frames as CoCGRCDD, so it is not an independent sample; merging longitudinal and transverse cracks into C12 removes orientation-specific labels; resolution, dates and route not reported
dataset.parent: CoCG Road Condition - Detection Dataset (same frames re-annotated with oriented bounding boxes)
dataset.viewEvidence: See Acquisition_Platform (reported: mounted) Vehicle-mounted USB Logitech Brio camera on the car radiator grille
dataset.vmount: Vehicle-mounted USB Logitech Brio camera on the car radiator grille
dataset.vnotes: Re-annotation of the same 2110 frames as CoCGRCDD, so it is not an independent sample; merging longitudinal and transverse cracks into C12 removes orientation-specific labels; resolution, dates and route not reported
dataset.labels: 3 defect classes plus per-frame scene attributes: shadow; painting; outlandish object; path milling; grain or binder defect; manhole
dataset.geography: Poland; Road environment: Urban road; Rural road

why:
A1 [Y]: A dataset-specific stable repository/deposit and the assessed release are identified; this is inventory identity, not verified retrieval.

A2 [Y]: The saved evidence describes the release access/download or request route; registration/restrictions do not reduce credit.

A3 [Y]: Data terms are explicitly recorded for the selected release. This does not clear upstream-component rights or intended-use compatibility.

L1 [Y]: The saved source describes the available targets and their meaning for this released task; no quality premium is assigned to boxes or masks.

L2 [Y]: Target encoding and a basic manual/measurement/derived-label procedure are jointly described; detailed annotator manuals are not required.

L4 [U]: No concrete target-review/correction/verification practice is established; multiple annotators, publication, file availability or generic quality claims alone do not qualify.

D1 [Y]: The recorded package structure, format and target mapping provide file-interpretation evidence; payload correctness remains untested.

D2 [Y]: The source summary identifies collection/compilation provenance and its method or named parent datasets.

D4 [Y]: Dataset-specific intended scope, selection exclusions or collection/annotation limitations are described in the source summary.

C1 [Y]: The saved evidence reports a released count with a stated observation unit; this does not establish independent captures.

C2 [Y]: The source reports quantitative class/outcome/subset accounting relevant to the documented task. It is not proof of statistical balance or independence.

R1 [Y]: Geography/site scope, pavement context and capture setting are jointly documented in the cited fields/source summary.

R2 [Y]: The source describes collection variation or an explicit restricted scope; breadth itself earns no bonus.

M1 [Y]: A useful collection platform, sensor or generation/derivation method is identified.

M2 [U]: Task-relevant resolution/sampling/measurement units are absent or only generically described; physical scale does not substitute for unspecified image dimensions in the image profile.

M5 [Y]: Preprocessing, cropping, resizing, filtering, fusion or explicit absence of augmentation is documented.
